description: The main window. Least privilege (AGENTS.md): the app's own commands and nothing else. The job commands (D0), the browsing commands (D1), the staging commands (D2), the extract plan command (D3), the foreign-archive commands (D8: open, close, list, plan an extract; a password is sent once in the open call and kept only in Rust), and the test, health, export, and repair setup commands (D4; the test and repair jobs themselves run through start_job). The native dialogs (open, choose sources, save, choose an extract folder, choose an archive to test or repair, a copy, the new archive, a report file) are shown from Rust and dropped paths are received by Rust, so the webview never names a path: no fs, shell, http, or dialog permission is granted, and core:default is not granted.
